premises.text: 5.4 billion people do not have smartphones and rely on SMS for communication
premises.evidence_span: there are 5.4 billion non-smartphones on the Earth right now

premises.text: SMS is an inadequate communication method compared to smartphone messaging
premises.evidence_span: how ugly an SMS looks like before iPhone came along. It wasn't threaded. It wasn't intuitive.

premises.text: People in emerging economies spend a significant portion of their income on messaging
premises.evidence_span: people spend up to 5% of their monthly income on just messaging

premises.text: An app can enhance SMS by providing threaded messaging and group messaging features
premises.evidence_span: users are able to send threaded iPhone-like threaded messaging on non-smartphones

premises.text: Location services can be added to non-smartphones through the app
premises.evidence_span: we bring location to non-smartphones, phones that don't have GPS

premises.text: The app can generate significant user engagement and downloads
premises.evidence_span: Within two months, we had 400,000 downloads of a beta app

premises.text: Advertising can serve as a monetization strategy in emerging economies
The platform can eventually provide internet access and services to non-smartphone users
premises.evidence_span: I see SEIA as a platform that is going to bring internet access to people

value.text: Non-smartphone users gain access to enhanced messaging and information services
value.evidence_span: we are giving billions of people in the world a mouthpiece to send messages and communicate

notes: Fundraising and conference details excluded as traction.
